acceptanceCriteria: StableCriterion accepts a plain Git blob span criterion with no Tasks fields; the Tasks fields are an optional, closed extension object that is validated when present.
A public stable case with no Tasks fields verifies identically on native and portable consumers; an existing Tasks-bound case keeps its result.
cem-stable-v1.md records CEM-V1-063 and the pilot-kit path produces a cem/1.0 map on a non-Corvint repository in a documented, timed walkthrough.
body: Source: decision 0523 (docs/decisions/0523-cem-1-0-rc3-verifier-computed-support-2026-10-11.md) and build-log docs/build-log/2026-10-11-cem-1-0-expert-panel.md, origin/main fb11b2274. Proposed CEM-V1-063. A criterion is any committed Git blob span holding acceptance text (issue template, spec, ADR, .taskman ticket). claimTicketSha256, captureSha256 and snapshotHead* in internal/cem/wire/stable.go move to an optional extension. A cem/1.0 map MUST verify with no Corvint Tasks store present. Kill criterion K4: a stranger produces and verifies a map on a non-Corvint repository within one engineer-day.
title: cem/1.0 P1: provider-neutral criterion; Tasks digests become an optional extension (must land before the V1-0595 freeze)
